title: Comprehensive SEO & Indexability Suite for Search Engines
highlights: Configured dynamic /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml endpoints for Googlebot and Bing indexing.
Engineered comprehensive JSON-LD structured schemas (WebApplication, WebSite with SearchAction, FAQPage).
Added high-CTR meta tags, Open Graph (OG), Twitter Cards, and canonical URL directives.
Integrated semantic H1 headings, feature highlights grid, and interactive FAQ accordion section.

title: Strict Email Format Verification & Real-Time Inline Validation
highlights: Enforced RFC-compliant regex validation on both client and server to reject invalid emails like 'treyt'.
Added real-time visual input cues and inline error message below the email field on input and blur.
Blocked form submission and focused the invalid field with descriptive guidance.

title: Mandatory Reporter Identity Fields (Name & Email Required)
highlights: Made Name and Email fields strictly required with visual indicator asterisks.
Added client-side and server-side email pattern validation to ensure reachable reporter contacts.

title: Strict Telegram Delivery Verification & Actionable Error Reporting
highlights: Removed silent fallback simulation to prevent false-positive success notifications when Telegram credentials are unconfigured or failing.
Surfaced clear, actionable error toasts when bot setup requires attention (missing tokens, /start not initiated, or invalid chat ID).
Preserved user input and prevented triggering 5-minute cooldown timer when delivery fails so users can retry immediately.

title: Pass Environment Variables to Docker Compose & Bulletproof Telegram HTML Parsing
highlights: Uncommented and explicitly mapped TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in docker-compose.yml environment block.
Switched Telegram Bot message formatting from strict Markdown to resilient HTML mode with entity escaping.
Enhanced HTTP error logging to inspect detailed API response bodies when Telegram rejects requests.

title: Precise Cooldown Timer with Seconds Display & Toast Deduplication
highlights: Enhanced the report cooldown notification to display precise minutes and seconds (e.g. 1m 24s, 45s).
Added real-time live cooldown countdown ticking directly on the report modal submit button.
Prevented stacking duplicate cooldown toasts when clicking submit multiple times.

title: Fix Spacebar Key Ingestion in Form Inputs & Description Field
highlights: Fixed global keyboard shortcut interceptor capturing spacebar presses when typing inside textareas and form input fields.
Ensured unobstructed typing across Bug Reporter form inputs, search fields, and future editable components.

title: Bug Reporter & Feedback System with Zero-Disk Telegram Forwarding
highlights: Integrated in-app Bug Reporter & Feedback dialog accessible from the footer.
Added support for image (PNG, JPG, WEBP) and video (MP4, WEBM) attachments with drag & drop and live media preview.
Implemented zero-disk streaming memory forwarder directly to developer's Telegram Bot.
Enforced multi-layered anti-spam protections: SlowAPI rate limiting, invisible honeypot trap, and client-side cooldowns.
Auto-collected non-intrusive diagnostic metadata (App Version, Platform/OS, Screen Resolution, Current Page URL).

title: Ambient Artwork Backdrop & Rich Artist Music Insights
highlights: Introduced immersive Spotify & Apple Music-style dynamic blurred ambient artwork glow behind the artist hero banner.
Added rich music statistics grid on the right side of the artist card featuring Career Span, Latest Album, Total Playtime, and Estimated MP3 Size.
Synchronized estimated discography download sizes dynamically with the active global download quality setting.
Designed clean responsive glassmorphic stat pill cards with custom neon vector iconography.

title: Global Download Quality Control & Streamlined Song Cards
highlights: Removed repetitive audio quality selectors from individual song cards for a much cleaner and decluttered interface.
Elevated quality selection to a unified global 'Download Quality' header bar with sleek glowing pill toggle buttons (128k, 192k, 320k).
Automatically applies active global quality setting across all single-track and batch downloads.
Updated download button tooltips to reflect current selected bitrates dynamically.

title: Fix Floating Volume Control & Release Log Button Overlap
highlights: Resolved collision where floating audio volume control slider rendered directly on top of the release log button.
Re-aligned volume control horizontally to the left of the release log button with harmonious vertical centering.
Configured synchronized vertical shifts when now-playing mini player opens to keep all bottom widgets collision-free.
Optimized compact sizing and spacing for mobile viewports.

title: Fix Search Autocomplete Stacking Context & Z-Index
highlights: Fixed CSS stacking context bug where loaded search result cards painted over autocomplete suggestions dropdown.
Assigned elevated z-index hierarchy to hero header and search form so recommendations always float on top of all content cards.
Added outside-click dismissal listener to immediately close suggestions when clicking background or results.

title: Production Domain Migration (melodyxx.eztec.biz.id)
highlights: Configured default allowed CORS origins for new production domain: https://melodyxx.eztec.biz.id.
Maintained backward compatibility with previous domain to prevent broken client requests.
Updated system documentation, environment references, and service worker cache layer.

title: Dismiss Autocomplete on Search Execution
highlights: Fixed race condition where autocomplete suggestions reopened over loaded search results.
Added immediate abort and debounce clearing upon form submission or search trigger.
Ensured search input blur drops focus and completely hides suggestion dropdown.
Introduced active search flag to prevent asynchronous responses from reopening dropdown.

title: Artist Photos, National Flags, and Clean Dropdown Backdrop
highlights: Added high-resolution artist portrait photos directly in the autocomplete dropdown.
Added artist country origin and national flag emojis in recommendation meta tags.
Made search suggestions dropdown background fully opaque to prevent empty state logo bleeding through.
Automatically hides empty-state illustration while typing or browsing suggestions.

title: Strict Artist Separation in Search Autocomplete
highlights: Fixed issue where song queries and discography popular songs appeared when searching in Artists mode.
Dedicated artist-only autocomplete pipeline returning 100% music artists with avatars and genres.
Strict compliance with zero auto-jump policy: selecting an artist always renders artist cards grid first.
Isolated in-memory suggestion caches between Songs and Artists modes.

title: Real-Time Search Autocomplete & Artist Recommendations
highlights: Real-time instant autocomplete dropdown when typing in the search command bar.
Smart top artist entity detection with glowing violet avatar, genre tag, and direct discography navigation.
High-speed YouTube query suggestions with prefix matching highlights and sub-millisecond in-memory caching.
Full keyboard navigation support (ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, Escape) and click-outside dismissal.
Zero OS emojis: 100% styled glowing violet vector SVGs matching Melodyxx design system.

title: Snappy Modal Transitions & Clean Release Notes Icon
highlights: Replaced star icon with dedicated, clean Release Notes document vector SVG.
Removed rotation spin on close (X) button, replaced with subtle smooth hover scaling.
Optimized modal transitions to high-performance 0.18s GPU-accelerated spring animations.
Preloaded changelog data on startup to eliminate layout shifts and perceived rendering lag.

title: 502 Stream Error & Download Manager Resilience
highlights: Fixed 502 Bad Gateway during batch downloads and external download managers (NDM/IDM).
Added multi-level on-the-fly YouTube stream refresh if Googlevideo CDN drops connection.
Integrated Node.js challenge solving runtime and ejs:github component for 100% n-challenge compliance.
Configured robust FFmpeg reconnect flags (-reconnect_on_http_error 4xx,5xx, -reconnect_on_network_error 1).
Optimized batch sequential pacing to 3s to prevent socket thrashing.

title: Release Log & What's New Drawer
highlights: Added floating circular launcher button in the bottom-right corner with seamless animations.
Interactive Release Log drawer displaying complete version history with exact timestamps and highlights.
Unread release badge with pulsing neon indicator that clears upon opening.
Full responsive glassmorphism UI styled in Melodyxx violet neon theme.

title: Flexible Artist Search & Smart Suggestions
highlights: Smart acronym and initialism expansion (e.g. searching 'h2h' instantly finds 'Hearts2Hearts', 'bmth' finds 'Bring Me The Horizon').
Interactive 'Did you mean:' suggestion chips bar for 1-click query expansion.
Load More Artists button expanding discovery results smoothly up to 48+ artists.
Multi-query parallel search pipeline merging exact, acronym, and related artist matches.

title: Symmetrical Update Banner Rotation
highlights: Fixed update notification banner refresh icon rotation alignment for 100% geometric center symmetry.

title: Batch Download Action Bar Positioning
highlights: Elevated floating batch download action bar above mini player when active to prevent layout overlaps.

title: Audio Buffering Loading Indicators
highlights: Added circular loading spinner animation to song play buttons during audio pre-buffering.

title: Custom Styled Search Input Clear Button
highlights: Replaced browser default search clear button with custom violet vector 'X' button.

title: Real-Time SSE Live Stream on Analytics
highlights: Live Server-Sent Events (SSE) telemetry connection with automatic 2-second reactive polling fallback.

title: Mandatory Admin Authentication on API
highlights: Protected /api/stats and /api/storage endpoints with secure admin authentication header verification.

title: Admin Key Gate for Analytics Dashboard
highlights: Added full-screen glassmorphic Admin Key authentication modal gating access to /stats.

title: Hero Section & Typography Modernization
highlights: Streamlined unified search bar with modern purple glow and responsive design.

title: Apple Music Artist Discography Explorer
highlights: Full artist discography browser with top popular tracks and album tracklist inspection.

title: Batch Sequential Download Queue
highlights: Multi-select download drawer with sequential stream pacing and retry failed tracks feature.

title: Initial Melodyxx Production Release
highlights: Zero-disk direct audio piping engine with official Apple Music 800x800 artwork embedding.
